name: B10-0171/2026 (S&D) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Georgia's government to stop its crackdown on its own people. It asks for the release of all political prisoners, including opposition politician Elene Khoshtaria and journalist Mzia Amaglobeli. It wants restrictive laws repealed and a return to democratic reforms that could reopen the path to European Union membership. It also asks the European Union to ban Georgian officials linked to the repression from entering the bloc, and to give more support to Georgian civil society and independent media. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The European Union is asked to ban responsible Georgian officials from entering and to fund civil society more.
- Georgian leaders, political prisoners, journalists and activists are affected.
- The European Union, member states and Georgia's government now receive the request; nothing changes automatically.
